decisions.reason: The Magento shop template fits the firm's e-commerce hosting clientele, but as a peripheral and easily substitutable add-on it is less secure than core services.
The responsive website template is adjacent to the firm's customer projects, yet template products are relatively commoditized and not as central as hosting and support.
Premium customer support directly reinforces the firm's agency-focused positioning and 24/7 service promise, so management would be very likely to retain it.
A software version management tool builds on the firm's technical know-how and supports its goal of reducing recurring operational work for customers.

The data processing contract tool is relatively distant from the firm's core hosting and support business, making it the most likely candidate to be discontinued in favor of core services or new development.
